messages.subject: Model Regressors with ts_par6 model
parts:
Dear All,

We are using the ts_par6() model for our study and we would also like to do an fMRI analysis on the data. To get the model regressors, we were trying to include 'ModelRegressors = TRUE' as one of the arguments while running the model as shown below:

output <- ts_par6(
+     data = dataALL, niter = 4000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 4, ncore = 4, modelRegressor = TRUE)

However, we are getting an error message which says that model regressors are not available for this model.

Is there any work-around to derive model regressors?

Hoping to hear from you soon!

Kind regards,
Pritha

messages.author: 47d1400f432367d7
messages.subject: Re: Model Regressors with ts_par6 model
parts:
Hi Pritha, 

Currently, that model does not have model regressors available. Unfortunately, this means that the only way to do it would be to modify the raw stan code to get what you need. 

I am not sure when model regressors will generally be available across models—Young may be better suited to answer that than I am at the moment!

Best,
Nate
